scientific_review: Exact paper-cited CSIRO collection v3 resolves to collection62713; file75441556 is11898461 bytes with pinned SHA256. Raw ocean-field download, header audit, tests and derivation ran only in cloud on one idle CPU. Raw NetCDF is not copied into the local repository.

File contains4292 daily records,2011-08-01 through2023-05-01, atWATR50 near31.7683S114.9567E. UCUR/VCUR are true east/north in m/s. DEPTH is metres below sea surface with86 levels at5m spacing. Source processed product flags distinguish observations, near-surface extrapolation, near-bottom extrapolation and SOM filling.

OSW method pools accepted daily vectors within each month or two-month phase, rotates to348degrees true, and traces the first adjacent negative-to-nonnegative mean-profile crossing below the strongest poleward0–200m core. No vertical gap bridging or deep return-flow jump. This is a zero of a mean profile, not an average instantaneous boundary or full-depth current thickness.

Twelve monthly candidates include nine adjacent crossings and three censored cases(March,August,November). Censored475m is a sampling-limit minimum reach of the local processed mean profile, not a physical current bottom, thickness or replacement for published seasonal limits.

Annual computed crossing297.917m is near the published approximate300m. August–September computed274.299m differs from the published approximate260m. February–March has no strict sign crossing through475m, unlike the published approximate350m zero-flow descriptor. In the computed February–March profile the along-current velocity at350m is about−0.001253m/s: near zero but negative. A strict sign-change operator and an approximate near-halt description need not agree. Exact cause of processing/averaging discrepancy is not established.

Observed-only sensitivity is retained with per-depth counts. It uses different coverage from the full processed product and is not an uncertainty interval or a full independent repeat. Daily pooling weights unequal record lengths; the paper’s daily11-day climatology processing and exact Figure8 construction are not claimed reproduced.

All candidate profiles remain provisional, outside the canonical current depth register. No complete seasonal boundary series, annual depth extrema, whole-route profile, volume, physical-state join or UI admission is claimed. Source publication’s approximate depths remain unchanged.

Seven cloud tests check rotation, first crossing versus return flows, missing-depth gaps, censored reach, absent poleward cores, invalid depth axes, paired source flags and unknown empty phases. Green computational tests do not resolve the scientific source comparison.
